description: Land Acquisition - Ganegedara & Ambalanpitiya, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically providing detailed notices for the acquisition of specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and claimant information) for public purposes. It contains no government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized administrative matters outside of land/property acquisition.
